clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Tainted Keg carries stolen dwarven stout laced with a lethal Forsaken brew made by Apothecary Lydon. Sent to imprisoned human farmers as refreshments, it tests poisons being developed by the Royal Apothecary Society.

Dun Garok's dwarven riflemen lost a barrel of Shindigger Stout to thieves. Apothecary Lydon mixed the stout with his newly refined Elixir of Agony. The Forsaken chose an ordinary drink to carry the poison, hoping it would escape suspicion. A familiar ale became a swift death sentence.
